segments.he: וְאָמַר רָבָא בַּר מַחְסֵיָא אָמַר רַב חָמָא בַּר גּוּרְיָא אָמַר רַב: תַּחַת יִשְׁמָעֵאל וְלֹא תַּחַת נׇכְרִי. תַּחַת נׇכְרִי וְלֹא תַּחַת חַבָּר. תַּחַת חַבָּר וְלֹא תַּחַת תַּלְמִיד חָכָם. תַּחַת תַּלְמִיד חָכָם וְלֹא תַּחַת יָתוֹם וְאַלְמָנָה.
segments.en: «And Rava bar Meḥasseya said» that «Rav Ḥama bar Gurya said» that «Rav said:» It is preferable to be «under» the yoke of «Ishmael and not under» the yoke of «a stranger,» the Romans; «under a stranger and not under a Ḥabar,» a Persian Zoroastrian fire priest; «under a Ḥabar and not under a Torah scholar,» as if one offends a Torah scholar who is greater than he, the scholar will be exacting with him and he will be punished at the hand of Heaven; «under a Torah scholar and not under an orphan or a widow,» as they are easily insulted and God promised to hear their cries and punish those who offend them.
